purpose: Short local Chrome/Edge synthetic audio, screen decode, TCP blackhole, liveness handover, and proof-based participant resume smoke.

expectedConnectionLiveness.note: Expected values supplied by the root-managed createApp test seam; the harness observes resulting peer state, not the timer internals.

topology.proxyBoundary: A alone uses an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 listener. It forwards raw TCP to the separate private app. B and C connect directly to that private app.
topology.initialMedia: A and B publish distinct synthetic Opus audio; A publishes a synthetic canvas screen; C uses native browser WebCodecs decode and AudioWorklet PCM output for both sources and decodes/renders the screen.

syntheticSources.audio: getUserMedia is replaced only in each isolated test page with oscillator-backed MediaStreamDestination tracks.
syntheticSources.screen: A getDisplayMedia call is replaced only in A's page with an animated canvas captureStream.

proxy.implementation: local raw TCP forwarder; no WebSocket frame rewriting
proxy.overflowBehavior: destroy the affected pair when the bounded delay/rate queue exceeds its cap; never discard arbitrary bytes and keep the stream active
proxy.blackholeBehavior: discard all bytes both ways for A's WebSocket pair, suppress the upstream close/FIN while blackholed, then destroy old pairs before fresh TCP reconnects are forwarded

limits.physicalNetwork: not-tested; this is a local TCP proxy on one computer, not Wi-Fi, WAN, cellular, Cloud Run, or a packet-loss model
limits.syntheticMedia: not-tested with physical microphones, OS screen picker, human listeners, or multiple physical devices
limits.humanAudioVideoSync: not-measured; source timestamp offsets, if shown by the app, are not human-observed synchronization or calibrated p95 latency
limits.longDurationAndQuality: optional local post-recovery soak 15000 ms; not a 65-minute or quality claim
limits.capacityAndCloud: not-tested; no capacity, cloud deployment, or Cloud Run claim

errors.failure: The private studio fixture must start unlocked for A's normal UI lock flow.
